segments.text: RIghteous art thou, O Lorde: and true is thy iudgement.
The teſtymonies that thou haſt cōmaunded: are exceadyng righteous and true.
My zeale hath euen conſumed me: becauſe myne enemyes haue forgotten thy wordes.
Thy worde is tried to the vttermoſt: and thy ſeruaunt loueth it.
I am ſmall and of no reputacion: yet do not I forgette thy commaundementes.
Thy ryghteouſnes is an euerlaſting righteouſnes: and thy lawe is the trueth.
Trouble and heauynes haue taken holde vpon me: yet is my delight in thy commaundementes.
The ryghteouſnes of thy teſtimonies is euerlaſtyng: O graunt me vnderſtanding and I ſhall lyue.
As it was in the begynning. &c.
